svg.title: The eight chapters and their recorded uses of one another
svg.desc: Eight chapters on a ring around the grammar, sized by their results (The root 86, The map 96, Knowing and testing 110, Life and evolution 46, Collectives and selection 74, The classical texts 16, Significance and alignment 101, Method and the formal core 21); 516 formal-reuse uses between chapters, 17 pairs with at least 10 drawn, 212 of the uses running backward, an earlier chapter's results using a later one's, drawn darker where a pair has 10 or more (the chapters are numbered for reading, not as an order of proof); spokes to the grammar give each chapter's core modules that state their laws on it (The root 22 of 74, The map 14 of 79, Knowing and testing 14 of 88, Life and evolution 8 of 23, Collectives and selection 3 of 28, The classical texts 4 of 10, Significance and alignment 19 of 70, Method and the formal core 4 of 26); the standings of the 117 central declarations against the edge of one root (11 derived, 1 under a stated hypothesis, 6 counting, 99 at a named distance); under the standings, the five shared laws with the central rows on each and those reaching the grammar (Closure 42 rows, 42 reach; Balance 54 rows, 16 reach, represented, not derived; Finite runs 14 rows, 14 reach; Lumping 2 rows, 1 reach; Widening 8 rows, 1 reach); the continuation condition (scope, whose losses count) and C (order) come into chapter 7 as readings, each a hypothesis where used, neither asserted; T1 to T8 at their homes, coloured by test outcome.
svg.text: The eight chapters and their recorded uses of one another
Drawn from the theory graph: each circle sized by its chapter’s results; each solid curve counting
one chapter’s uses of another’s results recorded as formal-reuse, dashed and dotted curves between
The chapters are numbered for reading, not as an order of proof: 212 of the 516 uses between
chapters run backward, an earlier chapter’s results using a later one’s (the darker curves; only
formal-reuse curves of pairs with 10 or more are drawn).
Standings of the 117 central declarations against the edge of one root (08 §7):
11 derived, each a case of grammar laws
99 at a named distance, each with its reason
The five shared laws (08 §7): central rows on each; hatched, those whose compiled type or value
Rows, not declarations: 87 of the 126 central rows (nine declarations stand in two) rest on at least one law,
some on several. Reaching the grammar is not being derived: only the 11 derived above are read as cases of
grammar laws, and 1 as a root form at one step, under a stated hypothesis. A bar of few rows is widened to be
seen; the words give the counts.
Two readings, each a hypothesis where used
scope: fixes whose losses count; does not rank
C, widening what can form is better
order: ranks a course above every course it widens;
frozen tests passed and failed, or a bridge
T1–T8 at their homes; what each claims, its standing
and its tests: the theses table in THEORY-GRAPH.md,
Circle: a chapter, its area by its results; its
number inside it; beside it, its name, its results
and the formal-reuse uses within it.
A use recorded as formal-reuse, a kind kept for “a
verified inference using the cited result”: the
arrow points to the chapter whose results are
used; the number beside a curve counts its uses,
written where it is 15 or more. The AI-written
records assign the kind; the registry checks that
an interface has its fields and cites a file among
the record’s hashed references (on 823 of all
1,228 such edges; each cites a Lean file); nothing
checks that the Lean there uses the cited result.
The same, darker where an earlier chapter’s
results use a later one’s: the chapters are
numbered for reading, not as an order of proof.
application, a reused result with its
Spoke: its width is the share of the chapter’s
core modules that state their laws on the grammar,
given beside the chapter as “k of m modules on the
grammar”. It counts modules, not results derived.
Not drawn: related, for analogy (1,473 edges), and
the formal-reuse curves of pairs under 10 uses;
counts under 15 are not written. THEORY-GRAPH.md’s
